name: Soul Gleaner
behaviour: Roams the spirit realm hunting souls rather than the hero. Each soul it devours heals it, raises its level and makes it bigger; at three it is Gorged and faster. Up close it fights. Killing one frees every soul it ate.
look: A hunched dark-violet robe with a pale skull, long bone arms tipped with cyan claws and a ring-shaped glowing maw.
lore: Scavengers of the Veil. Where a soul falls, a Gleaner is already drifting toward it.
